dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple interconnected irregular 'O' and 'C' shaped perimeters with jagged, non-uniform edges. High contrast transition from dark dorsal pixels to high-intensity light-colored boundary lines forming closed and semi-closed loops.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Low to moderate density of high-intensity pixel clusters without internal gradients, primarily concentrated at the vertices and intersection nodes of the light-colored reticulated lines.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three most prominent upper-right annuli form an obtuse triangle. The relationship between the center-top and mid-left annuli creates an elongated geometric vector across the horizontal axis of the frame.

other_distinctive_markers: The skin displays a continuous, complex reticulated pattern resembling a cellular lattice or mesh topology across the visible dorsal area.
